title: ISIN Validator
description: Validates an International Securities Identification Number (ISO 6166) using the Luhn check digit from floydspace/isin-validator. Takes an ISIN string (spaces and hyphens ignored, case-insensitive) and optional checkCountryCode / checkCheckDigit flags (both default true). Returns validity, canonical 12-character form, country code, NSIN, actual and expected check digits. Country codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 plus the source pseudo codes XS, XA, XB, XC, XD, XF, QS, QT, QW, EU and XK. Invalid input returns valid:false with error and message.

isin.description: ISIN to validate. Spaces, hyphens and surrounding whitespace are ignored; letters are case-insensitive.

checkCountryCode.description: When true (default), the first two letters must be a known country or pseudo code.

checkCheckDigit.description: When true (default), the final digit must match the ISO 6166 Luhn check digit.
